title: Atomic Mass
short: Read the atomic mass of an element.
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on read the atomic mass of an element.
Tip: Mass sits under the symbol and is usually about twice the number for light elements.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
